full_judgment: 4. The present petitioner and others being defendants contested the case by filing written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint and contending inter-alia that the petitioner and respondent No. 15 has been owning and possessing the land in dispute by way of purchase and after scrutinizing the papers and possession the Settlement Officer recorded the land in the name of the petitioner and other respondent in the respective khatian in the last Dhaka City Survey operation.
